output.headline: Most ECOs come back because the submitter has not captured the full scope of the change, especially the affected parts, with missing cost impact and out-of-date drawings close behind.

themes.name: Affected parts and where-used incomplete
themes.description: Reviewers return ECOs whose affected-items list stops at the top assembly or the drawing, leaves out changed child parts or fasteners, or has no where-used to show downstream impact.

quotes.quote: Only the top assembly is listed as affected. Add the child parts that change.
Affected parts list is missing the fasteners at find 10; please add them.
Where-used not attached, so we cannot see the impact on 100-008967.

themes.prevention: At submit, have PLM generate the BOM explosion and where-used for every changed item and block submission until each changed child part and find-number item is either added as affected or explicitly marked unaffected.

themes.name: Cost impact missing
themes.description: Reviewers return ECOs with a blank or missing cost impact, including no scrap and rework cost for existing stock that plants need for inventory disposition.

quotes.quote: No cost impact estimate. Plants need it for inventory disposition.
Add scrap and rework cost for existing stock of 210-008709.
Missing cost impact; board will not review without it.

themes.prevention: Make the cost impact section a required field at submit, with a structured line for scrap and rework cost of on-hand stock for each affected part.

themes.name: Drawing not updated or inconsistent with model
themes.description: Reviewers return ECOs where the attached drawing is still at the old revision, only a markup is attached, or the drawing disagrees with the model.

quotes.quote: Drawing for 330-005584 is still at the old revision; attach the updated drawing.
Drawing and model disagree on the hole pattern; update the drawing.
Markup attached but the released drawing is not updated.

themes.prevention: At submit, check that each affected part has a drawing at the new pending revision (not a markup), and that it was saved after the latest model change.

themes.name: Effectivity not workable
themes.description: Reviewers return ECOs whose effectivity date conflicts with the SAP cutover or with supplier stock run-out, or that lack serial-number effectivity for field units.

quotes.quote: Effectivity date conflicts with the SAP cutover; pick a date after it.
Effectivity date is before supplier stock runs out; align with purchasing.
Effectivity by serial number is missing for the field units.

themes.prevention: Add effectivity validation at submit that blocks dates inside the SAP cutover window, requires purchasing sign-off on stock run-out, and requires serial-number effectivity when field units are affected.

themes.name: Export classification missing
themes.description: Reviewers return ECOs that introduce new parts without an export classification or trade compliance review.

quotes.quote: New part 210-004633 has no export classification; route to Trade Compliance first.
Export review missing for the new bracket before release.

themes.prevention: Make export classification a required attribute on new parts and automatically route any ECO with an unclassified new part to Trade Compliance before technical review.

themes.name: Wrong change type
themes.description: Reviewers return ECOs submitted under the wrong change type, such as a design change that is really a supplier change or a document-only change.

quotes.quote: Change type should be supplier change, not design change.
This is a document-only change; resubmit as a document change.

themes.prevention: Replace free choice of change type with a short guided question set in the ECO template (form/fit/function change? source change? documentation only?) that sets the type.
